headline: How to breed the Plasma Dragon
title: How to Breed Plasma Dragon in Dragon Mania Legends | Fire + Energy | DML Breeding Guide
video_script: Want the Plasma Dragon in Dragon Mania Legends? Breed two dragons that together carry the Fire and Energy elements. Careful, Fire and Energy can also give you the Meteor Dragon, so you may need a few tries. Tip: higher level and rarer parents give you better odds of a rare dragon. Which dragon should I cover next? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Higher level parents = better rare odds

description: Dragon Mania Legends: breed two dragons that together carry Fire and Energy to get the Plasma Dragon. No combination is guaranteed; the same elements can also give the Meteor Dragon. Element combos checked on the DML wiki and the TouchTapPlay breeding guide.
